# RSA-2048 leaf signed with RSASSA-PSS under default parameters (SHA-1, MGF1-SHA1, salt 20), for the
# rule that our own chain never carries a SHA-1 PSS signature (no scheme codepoint names it).
# root_cert (self-signed, serial 1, sha256) -> leaf_cert (serial 2, CN=localhost, EKU serverAuth).
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.2.1 (validity 100 years from generation):
#   openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out X.key   (root, leaf)
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key root.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Pss Sha1 Test Root" -set_serial 1
#     -days 36500 -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign"
#   openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=localhost" -out leaf.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA root.pem -CAkey root.key -set_serial 2 -sha1 -sigopt rsa_padding_mode:pss
#     -sigopt rsa_pss_saltlen:20 -sigopt rsa_mgf1_md:sha1 -days 36500 -extfile leaf.ext
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth /
#               subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each field)
root_
leaf_
